missingness_rule: A missing source field remains null and carries a publisher or repository missingness reason. The product does not impute it.
pairing_rule: Matched specimen and aliquot identifiers are retained as publisher links. The product does not infer pairs.
partition_rule: The publisher declares no machine-learning train, validation, or test roles. This product creates none.
controlled_data_rule: Authorized records may be validated in place. The command reports counts only and does not copy records into this repository.
